correctness.rationale: The canonical cyclic (7,3,1) Fano model produces 14 vertices, 21 incidences and precisely 28 distance-three nonincidences each with exactly three geodesics. In a strong three-coloring girth six forces propriety at every vertex by unique distance-two geodesics. Exact recursion under one-vertex palette normalization exhausts 8 proper 3-edge-colorings and checks their seven obstructions; a 21-entry four-color certificate passes every shortest-path pair. Exhaustive matching enumeration at each size 0..7 counts 126 and 84 successes only at 4 and 5. An independently written binary projective PG(2,2) and perfect-matching factorization program obtains 48 labelled colourings and verifies all 91 pairs, all 48 repair spectra and the same numerical invariants. Actual attached program sources and recorded outputs were executed and compared. No partial enumeration is treated as exhaustive without the recurrence/combinatorial reductions.

value.rationale: The Fano Levi graph is the unique (3,6)-Moore cage, a natural finite-geometry test graph for rainbow edge-geodesic connectivity. The precise four-colour obstruction is motivated by the shortest-path invariant, while the repair problem asks how a conventional 3-edge-factorization can be made strongly geodesic-rainbow using one new matching colour without changing old assignments. Its complete, graph-intrinsic, independent-of-factorization enumerator identifies a nonmonotone phase: exactly four or five disjoint recolourings work, while none with six or seven do. This is a complete natural classification and a reproducible benchmark, not an arbitrary digit-slice or restatement of known perfect matching tables.
